summary: AAPTokenField is a secure field that fetches and stores an AAP OAuth2 token for all rhaap:* actions. Properties: title (default 'AAP Token'), description, ui:field: AAPTokenField, and ui:backstage.review.show (default true). The token comes from the AAP OAuth2 provider and is kept in Backstage secrets.
questions: How do rhaap actions get an OAuth token?
Does AAPTokenField show in the review step?
